name: Electropellers
summary: In Darkshore, Wizbang Cranktoggle asks anglers to recover his lost electropellers. He lost the prototype parts in freshwater streams after a mishap with an explosive duck decoy.

sections.title: A Tipsy Invention
sections.body: Wizbang Cranktoggle spends an evening searching inland Darkshore for a place to test his latest invention. The gnome tinkerer, stationed in Auberdine, has built a self-propelled, exploding duck decoy. After drinking too much, he blacks out and wakes hours later back in town with singed hair and an empty pack. His bag of electropellers has fallen into one of the coastal rivers.

sections.title: Dredging the Waters
sections.body: Wizbang asks local fishermen to dredge Darkshore's freshwater streams because he does not want to brave the wilds himself. Anglers fishing the Wildbend River and Cliffspring River can snag the buoyant metal parts alongside local fish. With the components recovered, the gnome can resume his erratic waterfowl experiments.

faq.q: Where do I find the electropellers?
faq.answer: Fish in Darkshore's freshwater rivers and lakes, including the Cliffspring River and Wildbend River. The electropellers cannot be found in the ocean along the coast.
Wizbang Cranktoggle is an eccentric gnomish engineer who lives in Auberdine. He makes bizarre, explosive inventions and relies on travelers to gather lost components and oddities for his experiments.

faq.q: What was Wizbang trying to build?
faq.answer: Wizbang was building a self-propelled, exploding duck decoy. After drinking too much, he accidentally detonated an early prototype, scorching his hair and losing his bag of parts in the water.

faq.q: Can electropellers be found in fish schools?
faq.answer: No. Electropellers come from open freshwater casts, not special schools such as Lesser Oily Blackmouth nodes.
Complete Gaffer Jacks first. It is an earlier fishing task Wizbang assigns to test your angling luck in the local waters.
No. Enemies and ground containers do not yield electropellers; you must retrieve them from rivers using a fishing pole.

angles.text: As a gnome, you may recognize Wizbang's chaotic ambition to build exploding duck decoys, though losing expensive parts in an elf-guarded river is embarrassing.
As an engineer, you can see electropellers as curious examples of miniaturized gnomish propulsion, made to drive mechanical decoys before violently combusting.
As a night elf, you may look on Wizbang's loud, smoky inventions and river-littering mishaps with quiet disapproval. Darkshore's streams should remain natural.
